versions.changelog: Run result files are signed URLs that need no other credential and expire about 10 minutes after the result.

New upload_workspace_file tool (24 tools). Finished workers' changes merge into the Workspace automatically; submit a changeset only for a worker that failed or was stopped. Runs started through MCP can generate images, not video.
Initial release: the Plori skill as served at plori.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/plori/SKILL.md
